# Issue Templates

> Templates for reporting bugs and proposing features.

| Template | Use for |
|----------|---------|
| [bug_report.md](./bug_report.md) | Something in the repository is wrong or broken |
| [feature_request.md](./feature_request.md) | Proposing new content, scripts, or improvements |

## Writing a good issue

- **Search first.** The content may already exist or be planned.
- **One topic per issue.** Unrelated problems are much harder to reproduce.
- **Include context.** Power BI version, source system, and whether the issue
  reproduces in Desktop, Service, or both.
- **Reference existing files by path** rather than pasting long excerpts.
